title: Comparing group selection rates
description: You can trace the supplied threshold into two descriptive group comparisons.

steps.description: A score greater than 75 marks selected as True. You average these Boolean values within each group to obtain selection rates.
The code subtracts B's rate from A's and divides B's rate by A's. You format both comparisons to three decimal places.

steps.question: Which branch of the printed label does the recorded ratio select?
steps.answer: The ratio 0.368 is below the code's 0.8 cutoff, so the label selects FAILS.

steps.description: You see rates 0.340 and 0.125, difference 0.215 and ratio 0.368. The final label reports the result of this coded threshold comparison.
